active_hypotheses.minimum_evidence: one attributable eligible decision with an explicit action or withholding outcome; a filled event additionally requires reconciled protection and a resolved lifecycle before any economic update

hypothesis_decisions.decision_reason: Monitor mode previously launched the cockpit before a recovered checkpoint writer published its first exact fresh checkpoint; the launcher now waits for matching profile, run, staged configuration, and accounting identity or fails closed.
The generic pullback identity was negative in causal replay and was replaced by the distinct alignment-v2 identity.
Measured missing-onset paths were adverse after estimated friction, so relaxing the onset requirement remains closed.
hypothesis_decisions.reopen_condition: A separately versioned causal mechanism must remain positive on both supported sides across chronological and untouched evidence after largest-winner removal.

hypothesis_decisions.decision_reason: All tested generic completed-bar profit-lock families underperformed the frozen control.
hypothesis_decisions.reopen_condition: A distinct causal exit family must beat the unchanged control on chronological and untouched evidence without largest-winner dependence.

hypothesis_decisions.decision_reason: The opposition-loss rule remained negative without its largest winner and harmed the opened later confirmation.
hypothesis_decisions.reopen_condition: A newly versioned causal mechanism must stay positive after costs and largest-winner removal and outperform the unchanged control on untouched evidence.

hypothesis_decisions.decision_reason: Development improved modestly, but later confirmation produced no floor triggers and remained insufficient for adoption.
hypothesis_decisions.reopen_condition: An independent completed floor trigger with resolved costs plus a predeclared positive forward window after largest-winner removal.

hypothesis_decisions.decision_reason: The decision-minute implementation consumed pre-publication candle data. The repaired contract begins at the first complete minute after candidate availability, and the exact first-hour evidence was recomputed and independently hash-verified.

The first 1.680924 live hours contained no eligible entry, but that result has approximately 98.3% probability under the frozen central cadence sensitivity and approximately 95.0% under an optimistic upper-rate sensitivity. No entry relaxation or route addition is supported by this short window.

Frozen signal timestamps support predeclared technical, cadence, and material-deviation reviews at 24 hours, 7 days, and 14 days. The schedule prevents premature gate loosening and does not create automatic strategy authority.

The bounded opening prefix had complete causal telemetry and every non-action reconciled to absent or opposed frozen route conditions. No signal-plumbing defect, entry relaxation, or live strategy change is supported.

The bounded live prefix had exact long-side and structural-long parity with zero mismatches; both sides and opposite-intent close ordering pass the exact v52 implementation tests. No one-sided defect or exit repair is supported before the first eligible lifecycle.

Every 40-300-bps target lost after modeled costs. The development-selected 500-bps target remained positive but cut native aggregate net by 1269.50 bps and made the long slice negative; the later-confirmation long never triggered it and no independent short confirmation exists.
hypothesis_decisions.reopen_condition: A predeclared independent both-side or explicitly side-specific fixed-target experiment must beat native total and leave-largest net after executable costs without materially degrading the opposite direction.

hypothesis_decisions.decision_reason: The predeclared 20-path review threshold was reached. Twenty-two independent five-minute long-side paths had a -14.63 bps after-friction mean, -15.44 bps largest-winner-removed mean, only two cost-clearing closes, and no robust favorable excursion; longer resolved horizons did not provide breadth-stable support.
hypothesis_decisions.reopen_condition: A separately versioned causal mechanism or materially different predeclared regime window must produce at least 20 independent same-side paths with positive after-cost mean and median, positive largest-winner-removed mean, and nonzero robust-MFE breadth.

hypothesis_decisions.decision_reason: One v52 aligned non-compression onset was mixed across fixed horizons, while the prior broad aligned-only arm lost across 509 development and 115 opened-final lifecycles. Compression and pullback prerequisites remain unchanged.
hypothesis_decisions.reopen_condition: A predeclared independent same-blocker sample must become positive after realistic costs and largest-winner removal, and an occupancy-aware both-side replay must improve the exact v52 contract without materially worsening drawdown or execution quality.

hypothesis_decisions.decision_reason: The only exact v52 breakout-side-opposed one-blocker path was negative after the fixed diagnostic hurdle at five, fifteen, and sixty minutes and positive only at thirty minutes. One readiness path is neither a fill nor an exact-route lifecycle, so alignment remains unchanged.
hypothesis_decisions.reopen_condition: At least 20 independent exact one-blocker episodes with both structural sides must survive executable costs and largest-winner removal under predeclared horizons, followed by an exact-route stop-and-exit replay.

hypothesis_decisions.decision_reason: The report-only audit previously left one-sided Hulk and BTC sweep readiness annotations directionless. Exact configuration-bound attribution now labels all 9 Hulk rows short and all 4 sweep rows long, leaves bidirectional nulls ambiguous, and creates no eligibility, actions, fills, or PnL.

Only two independent long-side one-blocker episodes exist. Their 5m and 15m after-friction means are negative; the 30m mean is approximately flat and becomes -23.28 bps without its largest close; 60m has only one resolved positive path and one censored path. The primary sweep trigger remains unchanged.
hypothesis_decisions.reopen_condition: At least 12 independent one-blocker episodes, or a separately predeclared causal replay of the exact candidate, must remain positive after executable costs and largest-winner removal under the intended stop and target. This is a diagnostic review threshold, not automatic promotion authority.

hypothesis_decisions.decision_reason: Both saved long and short holdouts had PF below 0.4 and strongly negative after-cost returns, while saved-evaluation and runtime exit contracts differ.
hypothesis_decisions.reopen_condition: A newly identified exact causal source revision with matching runtime and replay exits must be positive on frozen chronological and untouched evidence after exact costs and largest-winner removal.

hypothesis_decisions.decision_reason: Every predeclared arm, symbol-side cell, and OOS model selection was negative under nominal and stress costs.
hypothesis_decisions.reopen_condition: A materially different preregistered event mechanism must clear the gross cost hurdle before modeling and remain positive in untouched evidence.

hypothesis_decisions.decision_reason: Both exact arms were negative before fees and after costs in every fold, symbol-side cell, and causal regime slice across 15,321 lifecycles.
hypothesis_decisions.reopen_condition: Only a materially new causal event definition with preregistered thresholds and positive pre-fee expectancy can reopen this family.

hypothesis_decisions.decision_reason: Selected predicted gross returns stayed below measured execution hurdles and both models produced zero qualifying trades.
hypothesis_decisions.reopen_condition: A new causal feature or event family must show OOS gross edge above measured costs before leverage or threshold changes.

hypothesis_decisions.decision_reason: No tested candidate remained positive across all chronological segments; the strongest SOL long variants failed pseudo-holdout.
hypothesis_decisions.reopen_condition: A separately preregistered mechanism must survive untouched chronology, realistic friction, and largest-winner sensitivity without selecting a side after outcomes are visible.

hypothesis_decisions.decision_reason: Both original exit variants and all later measured horizons remained negative; this is distinct from live HYPE alignment-v2.
hypothesis_decisions.reopen_condition: A distinct HYPE mechanism with new identity must beat alignment-v2 on shared timestamps and untouched evidence after exact costs.

hypothesis_decisions.decision_reason: The corrected route-native snapshot produced one deployable resolved loss and the earlier five exact missing-cross counterfactuals were also negative in aggregate.
hypothesis_decisions.reopen_condition: A new preregistered causal SOL mechanism, or at least 12 independent deployable episodes, must remain positive after exact costs and largest-winner removal.

hypothesis_decisions.decision_reason: Thirty-three events were negative after nominal costs and the one fully exhausted event was 100 percent largest-winner dependent.
hypothesis_decisions.reopen_condition: A prospective capture must accumulate at least 20 full exhaustion events with at least five per symbol under the same receipt-causal feature contract.

hypothesis_decisions.decision_reason: All retests and the least-bad failed-breakout fade were negative in aggregate and most chronological folds.
hypothesis_decisions.reopen_condition: A distinct preregistered mechanism must be fold-stable, positive after costs and largest-winner removal, and outperform alignment-v2 on shared timestamps.

hypothesis_decisions.decision_reason: The one-year deployed-shape replay lost money with PF 0.6193, and alternative stop-target geometry remained negative.
hypothesis_decisions.reopen_condition: A new causal entry mechanism with distinct identity must remain positive across untouched partitions after exact friction and largest-winner sensitivity.

hypothesis_decisions.decision_reason: All six residual pairs lost, none of 90 exit-surface cells was positive, and none of 15 impulse cells survived delayed and fold-stability checks.
hypothesis_decisions.reopen_condition: Only a separately versioned causal mechanism or materially changed predeclared regime, universe, or execution source may reopen this family; it must use untouched validation and holdout plus stress and largest-winner sensitivity.

change_proposals.recommendation: Repair HYPE soft-hold extension so stale or partial regime evidence cannot prolong exposure beyond eight hours.
change_proposals.why_now: The exact defect is reproducible before the first v52 HYPE lifecycle has opened.
evidence_reviewed: Exact v52 config and source hashes
Deterministic stale and partial evidence probes
Maximum-hold, routing, restart, and stop-preserving exit tests
change_proposals.observed_problem_or_opportunity: The eight-hour policy can extend from indefinitely retained evidence or from only one of the required provider and canonical sources.
change_proposals.applicable_market_regime: Every HYPE lifecycle that reaches the eight-hour soft boundary, especially during partial telemetry failure.
alternatives_considered: Force every HYPE exit at eight hours
change_proposals.proposed_live_change: Implement and test a versioned HYPE maximum-hold evidence freshness contract requiring both provider and canonical evidence to be non-future and no older than 60 seconds before extension.
change_proposals.expected_upside: Prevent stale or incomplete evidence from extending capital exposure while retaining fresh regime-supported winners.
main_risks_and_failure_modes: False exit during a telemetry delay
validation_completed: Existing exit and protection suite passed 117 tests
success_metrics: No extension from missing, future, or older-than-60-second evidence
Hard deadline, stop, and opposite-signal exits remain unchanged
